purpose: Persistent ORCL evidence-to-earnings/cash/valuation and separate descriptive traversal tracker dossier
precedence: local configuration; record conflict rather than silently override

objectives.objective: 2026-2030 EPS with evidence classes and scenario valuation
Quarterly accepted capacity-to-cash bridge and current traversal

thesis.statement: Database/application distribution plus cloud capacity can expand earnings, if capital conversion and per-share cash generation justify the investment.
falsifiers: Repeated acceptance/billing delays against lease commencements
Legacy/customer economics erode faster than new recurring profits
Unplanned financing materially reduces per-share economics

watchpoints.review_trigger: Any committed milestone slips or billing starts after fixed costs
watchpoints.required_evidence: Customer acceptance evidence, delivery dates and revenue start schedule

watchpoints.measure: OpenAI liquidity, payment evidence, concentration and restrictions
watchpoints.review_trigger: Funding shortfall, payment delay, renegotiation or weaker security
watchpoints.required_evidence: Instrument terms; distinguish Oracle funding from customer funding

watchpoints.review_trigger: Costs commence before customer acceptance; unexplained cash gap
watchpoints.required_evidence: Cohort schedule; classify operating vs finance leases

watchpoints.measure: CFO, prepayments, capex, vendor principal and economic replacement
watchpoints.review_trigger: H2FY28 FCF-positive or FY29 30B+ target delayed; deterioration not explained
watchpoints.required_evidence: Reconcile reported FCF and financing-adjusted owner cash

watchpoints.measure: Infrastructure margin vs database/apps profit and cost leverage
watchpoints.review_trigger: Consolidated margin guidance cut or ramped cohorts fail unit economics
watchpoints.required_evidence: Reconcile GAAP and adjusted gross/operating margins

watchpoints.measure: Common issuance, awards, preferred conversion, debt maturity and net interest
watchpoints.review_trigger: Unplanned equity, worsening matched bond spread or refinancing costs

watchpoints.measure: Cloud growth, legacy support decline, migration and recurring spend
watchpoints.review_trigger: Legacy erosion exceeds migration contribution; agent use fails monetization
watchpoints.required_evidence: Customer retention and organic growth where disclosed; missing remains null

watchpoints.measure: Availability -> production usage -> reliability -> paid economics
watchpoints.review_trigger: Outage/security/agent-control failure; new hardware delivery unsupported

watchpoints.measure: Capital-return discipline, disclosure revisions, incentives and pledges
watchpoints.review_trigger: Unexplained forecast changes; shareholder pledge stress; executive departure
watchpoints.required_evidence: Proxy/current filing; avoid inferring forced sales from pledged stock alone

watchpoints.measure: QQQ/NVDA/IBM returns; credit spreads; 2y/10y/real rates; oil
watchpoints.review_trigger: ORCL-specific residual weakness with issuer credit deterioration
watchpoints.required_evidence: Matched-session entitled FETCH receipt; rolling fit without lookahead

watchpoints.measure: Qualified customers -> deployment -> paid consumption -> cash
watchpoints.review_trigger: Certification delayed, deployment absent, AI bundled without paid expansion
watchpoints.required_evidence: Bottom-up buyer budgets and disjoint revenue attribution

freshness.historical_quote: M01 historical only; no current quote eligibility
freshness.fundamentals: Historical filing truth retained; recheck filings before current analysis
freshness.consensus: Dated web aggregate; requery each use and retain vendor accounting caveat
freshness.leadership_and_partnerships: Recheck each full review and material events
freshness.contract_terms: Unknown until received; issuer example never substituted for executed terms
freshness.market_data_rule: Request existing FETCH update before reading; inspect local per-day JSONL; do not build competing ingestion

planned_nodes.input: site acceptance/billing, lease commencement/payment, capex and debt schedules
planned_nodes.output: quarterly revenue, GAAP/adjusted EPS and owner-cash sensitivity

planned_nodes.input: same-vintage recurring diluted EPS/FCF and matched prices
planned_nodes.output: justified comparable range with explicit adjustment evidence

planned_nodes.input: accepted B02 receipt and B06 results
planned_nodes.output: narrow touch zones and up/down dollar-volume movement metrics

Forward diluted employee-award schedule and exact tax/interest reconciliation
Capitalized interest and cohort equipment economic replacement cash
Quarterly commencement schedule for additional lease commitments
Unbundled agent AI revenue, retention and margin contribution
Dollar TAM with overlap removed and competitive capture evidence
Current matched peer multiples and market/traversal inputs
